newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 728-day bond priced at 97.02 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 728-day bond priced at 97.02 pct.

text.p: The average price of a 728-day OFZ interest-bearing bond was 97.02 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the price would be in the 96.14-100.50 percent range.
The series 24014 bonds, maturing on June 16, 1999, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 98.52 to yield 23.22 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
In rouble terms the coupon rate amounts to 88,457 roubles.
On Wednesday the Finance Ministry also raised 4.64 trillion roubles by selling 364-day GKO discount Treasury bills, making total proceeds from today's auctions 7.14 trillion roubles.

It has paid 361.7 billion roubles in interest and repaid up to 4.81 trillion roubles on a maturing issue of series 24008 bonds on a voluntary basis. It also repaid 7.48 trillion roubles in maturing 161-day T-bills (series 220690).
